source: audit/local_gap_osm.py OH candidates (audit/local_gap_2026-09-25.json) widened to every OSM campsite in Ohio with no entry within 1.5 km (473; local ones picked by hand), plus the MWCD, Great Parks, Metroparks Toledo and Butler County MetroParks rosters
note: Second local-gap sweep. OSM's local-tagged pool is thin in Ohio (20 unmatched, mostly metroparks tent/backcountry sites), so candidates also came from every unmatched OSM campsite read by hand and from the Good Sam directory (241 OH campgrounds; its PUBLIC_PARK rows with no entry nearby were Tappan, Charles Mill, Clendening, Leesville North Fork, New London, Lake Snowden, Winton Woods). 11 added as ownership local (13344-13354); 18 excluded. MWCD now 9 of 9 campgrounds held except Seneca's seasonal Marina Point and Eagle Point (folded into Charles Mill). mwcd.org and reserve.mwcd.org refuse scripted fetches (403/405), so MWCD inclusion evidence cites MWCD page text as quoted in search results. Lake Snowden is owned by Hocking College (a public college), filed as local. The same Good Sam match also surfaced ~100 unmatched PRIVATE Ohio campgrounds (several KOAs and Jellystones among them), outside this pass.
